mentions.name: WhimFiles
mentions.description: A lightweight native Mac file manager (only 9 MB) with dual panes, tabs, fuzzy go-to-folder navigation, batch rename, file filtering, and other quality-of-life features for organizing files.
mentions.problem: Started as a way to clean up the Downloads folder and get an easy way to filter files.
mentions.source_excerpt: One is called WhimFiles and is a file manager for Mac that is only 9 MB. It started out with me wanting to clean up my Downloads folder and wanting an easy way to filter files.
